A Memorable First Michelin-Starred Experience
Aug 2026 • Couples
This was my first experience dining at a Michelin-starred restaurant, and overall, it was a very memorable one. The atmosphere was elegant and comfortable, and the staff were warm, friendly, and attentive throughout the evening.

While there were a few minor details that could have been better, I really enjoyed the food. The dishes were not only delicious but also creative and interesting, with unique flavors and textures that made the whole experience exciting and memorable.

I would definitely recommend the wine pairing, as it added another dimension to the meal. My only regret was that, as I have a relatively small appetite, I wasn’t able to finish everything.

Overall, the kind and welcoming staff, beautiful atmosphere, and impressive food made this a wonderful first Michelin-starred dining experience.

Excellent food, but let down by slow service
Apr 2026 • Couples
We visited La Maison whilst staying at the Intercontinental - needless to say we were excited to try the restaurant, though was a little dubious as to the price tag (less so the food given its Michelin Star status....though this is Vietnam and WILDLY more expensive than any other meal we had, but surprised that the matching wines were priced at the same rate as the food. 

We were welcomed by the team & showed to the table. The food was exceptional - incredibly tasty & beautifully presented. Food aside, I feel this is where we were let down. The delay across the tasting menu (6 courses) took more than 3 hours to complete, with long gaps between the earlier courses, then quick succession during the latter courses. On multiple occasions the wine was delivered either way too early to accompany the food and once the wine turned up after the food. Given the price tag of the matching wines, I would expect wines to actually accompany the food. 

Would I want to eat the food again? Yes it was delicious. Would I go for the matched wines - definitely not at that price. Did we have a good evening? Overall yes, but feel let down by the delays in service and timing of the wine. Would we go again? Probably not.

The first and only Michelin-starred restaurant in Central Vietnam
Feb 2026 • Friends
I dined at La Maison 1888 in InterContinental Danang Sun Peninsula Resort, the first and only Michelin-starred restaurant in Central Vietnam, and it was a truly special experience.

On the day I visited, Christian Le Squer from Le Cinq (3 Michelin stars) was there in person and served his dishes himself.

His signature Spaghetti debout en gratin was the highlight—visually unique and beautifully executed. The top had a light crispness while the inside was soft, rich, and perfectly balanced with truffle, ham, and mushrooms. After one bite, it was easy to understand why this dish is so well known.

The Potato Gnocchi “Boulangère” was also outstanding—light, delicate, and almost melting in the mouth.

A memorable dining experience, made even more special by the chef’s presence. ✨
